routes.method: Natural sequential route generator only; no combat, inventory, purchases or event acceptance. All optional event inventory conditions are eligible in this standalone model.

rewardChains.method: Route + actual createChest reward-generator model, not a completed adventure. Fixed level 10 and starting gear/luck, optional rooms eligible. Includes scheduled combat waves and chest/vault rooms; excludes event choices and shop purchases, combat RNG, victory-condition extra rerolls and survival. FirstSeen is a modeled generated chest, NOT naturally owned gameplay loot.

sourceDraws.method: Actual rarityRoll source sampler, fixed fate [3,4] and starter effective luck. Shop lines measure the deep bonus roll; complete shop offers also keep their original lower-tier minimum. No event-specific guaranteed floors or rich-chest lifts included.

adventures.method: Full real game transitions from fresh floor 1 seeds, no debug gear, no skipped enemies, no HP edits. Offline policy buys expected upgrades, invests talents, forges weapon to +9, fuses unprotected low-tier materials and accepts the first affordable non-leave event. Forecast rendering is disabled only for speed. This is simulation, not human/browser play. Finishing-roll trigger counts undercount non-finishing activations.

auditNotes: maxSerializedCodeUnits is JavaScript string.length, not UTF-8 bytes; the initial field name maxSerializedBytes was corrected without altering values.

The original adventure observer did not record the final cleared checkpoint. Original 200-floor runs have no checkpoint 200; four 400-floor runs do include checkpoint 200, but not 400. The simulator now observes its terminal state. deep-terminal-supplement.json is an additional complete 400-floor seed replay with checkpoint 400; original missing values were not fabricated.

UI penetration-tradeoff wording was added after the combat comparison audit; underlying expected-score deltas and combat rules are unchanged. The original adventure seed policy therefore remains the same.

The original audit stdout labeled a performance.now() millisecond interval as durationSeconds. The JSON now retains that measurement under durationMilliseconds and provides the converted durationSeconds. The script is corrected; original stdout is retained unedited.
